fit: Use original 12 training houses and four calibration houses only. Primary labels gain_newly_eligible. Six official categories and ten curated scene categories. Original and new four-house validation panels are excluded from fitting and model selection. Keep all zero and tie rows.
architecture: Predict short-term regional visual embeddings under each candidate action sequence. Freeze pretrained image/text encoders and V5/V6. Start a small JEPA residual from the frozen V7 visual residual trained on these same training houses. Measure a route's relative compatibility with the query versus a fixed bank of the 16 training text vectors. Subtract the mean of the bank for every route. A predeclared optional target-independent planned-displacement prior can be added and is always scored alone as the no-word control.
train_loss: Seed 47, deterministic two-thread CPU; AdamW 0.001, weight decay 0.02, batch 12. Each batch draws equal numbers of complete fixed rows and start/budget groups having at least one pair of queries with opposite directional preferences. Doubly center clipped gain labels within candidate and available training queries; predict that interaction, rank query-specific positive directions, and explicitly rank the difference between opposing word preferences on the exact same branch pair. Preserve future visual feature cosine/relative JEPA loss. No branch-end pixels or labels as policy inputs.
choose: Select only epoch in {4,8,12} and displacement-logit scale in {0,0.75,1.5}. On four calibration houses score both official and derived domains. Maximize the smaller of the two domains' correct-minus-strongest(wrong,no-word,displacement) net new-instance gains, plus 0.02 times mean double-difference accuracy minus 0.5. Tie break higher official absolute net gain, then lower displacement scale, then earlier epoch. A single resulting checkpoint goes to independent evaluation; no switching after results.
evaluate: Use a newly allocated, untouched second set of four houses, four physical starts each, each branch/target at its available 4/12/24-action budgets. All-zero rows included; average repeated masks and horizons within physical starts, then average houses equally. Record V6, original frozen V7, observed-only with the new scoring head, fixed within-domain cyclic wrong query, no-word control, displacement, and retaining uniform source frontier. Without the actual MOST VLM the reference cycles over available legal candidate indices.
gate: Require all on new houses: (1) eligible opposite-direction cases spread over at least two homes in either domain, (2) official correct-word gain exceeds zero, matched wrong-word gain, no-word gain and V6 gain; (3) derived correct-word gain exceeds wrongly permuted and no-word gains; (4) on joint official+derived conflicting-word physical pairs, house-equal double-difference accuracy exceeds 0.50 and exceeds observed-only; (5) across the two domains, correct-word minus planned-displacement gain must be positive in at least one domain. Coverage and uncertainty reported. If any requirement fails do not launch additional paid trials.
